subject: Unexpected bruising - warfarin patient
body: 72-year-old male patient on warfarin 5mg daily for atrial fibrillation presented with unusual bruising on forearms and lower legs over the past week. He denies any falls. He reports he was previously told not to take aspirin by his cardiologist due to bleeding risk and has been avoiding it. His most recent INR drawn 5 days ago was 2.8 (therapeutic range 2.0-3.0). No new medications have been started. Kidney function: eGFR 68 ml/min/1.73m2.
